text: E hoore Alyahuudaaɓe ɓen kan, Men harminno ko Men fillani maa kon (wano ka Aaya 156 nder cortewol An-'Aami ngol). Men tooñiraano ɓe harmingol ɗin, si ko woni, ko kamɓe wonunoo e tooñirde ko'e-maɓɓe faggitagol ko leptata ɓe; Men yoɓitiri ɓe bewre maɓɓe nden, Men harminiri ɗi e maɓɓe yagginirgol ɓe.
